title: Spanish Gold, Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop dealing with flimsy towel bars and mismatched hardware—this 30-inch wall-mount towel bar delivers a clean, coordinated look — available in Spanish Gold, which presents a rich, warm golden tone with European-inspired elegance, bringing luxury and sophistication to distinguished bathrooms. Backed by a lifetime warranty, it’s crafted from solid brass for enduring everyday bathroom use.

  • Spanish Gold elevates the room with luxe gold tones
  • Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Saves space with a wall-mounted design—ideal for busy bathrooms
  • Holds up to 10 lb for confident daily use
  • Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives

Complete your bathroom with matching pieces from the Que New collection—designed to coordinate with other matching Que New accessories and transitional bathroom hardware.

Specs

  • Product type: Towel bar (straight bar)
  • Size: 30 Inch
  • Center-to-center: 30 in
  • Bar diameter: 0.5 in
  • Overall depth: 33 in
  • Overall height: 3 in
  • Mounting: Wall mount; concealed screw mounting
  • Weight capacity: 10 lb
  • Included: Towel bar, mounting plates and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 X1 1/4"
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
meta_description: 30-inch wall-mount towel bar in solid brass with concealed screws and 10 lb capacity. Traditional/transitional Que New style, backed by a lifetime warranty.
